paper_title: Axion-Induced Patchy Screening of the Cosmic Microwave Background
notes: This paper forecasts the sensitivity of CMB patchy-screening searches (photon-axion conversion in LSS magnetic fields) to g_agamma for axion masses 2e-13 to 3e-12 eV. It performs no data analysis; it projects that a Planck+unWISE component-separated <T^a g> analysis could reach g_agamma ~ 3e-12 GeV^-1, and CMB-S4 could extend this by ~1 order of magnitude. Abstract and Sec. 1/4 state these are forecasts, and the actual data analysis is deferred to a separate future publication (ref [43]). Therefore is_projection=true and no measured limit is reported.
